exposure: Systemic inflammatory indices (WBC, NEU, LNF, PLT, NLR, dNLR, PLR, PNR, SII, MON, PMR, SIRI)
cohort: The study included 240 pregnant women, with 120 diagnosed with pregestational diabetes (40 T1DM, 80 T2DM) and 120 control pregnant women.
finding: First trimester NLR and last trimester APRI score may serve as additional tools for predicting perinatal outcomes, including low birth weight, preterm delivery, and NICU admission, in pregnancies complicated by pregestational diabetes.
